page_title: MNU 1-1 WOL | Manchester Utd v Wolves 30/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) was quite harsh and Thomas Bramall didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+5' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) replaces Jhon Arias.
90+5' Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.

90+4' Jack Fletcher (Manchester United) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
90+4' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+3' The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner. The corner from Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) is cleared away by the defence.
90+3' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Manchester Utd will take a corner kick.
90+1' The goal by Manchester Utd is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
90+1' Wait! Referee Thomas Bramall immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90' A goal, which was scored by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United), was disallowed due to offside.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Bendito Mantato (Manchester United) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
88' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Fernando Lopez.
86' Casemiro (Manchester United) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
85' Total attempts – 13:11.

83' Jose Sa pulls off a fantastic save! Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the right post, but the effort is kept out.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolves comes to nothing.

80' This shall not pass! Jhon Arias (Wolves) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
78' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
77' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
75' Ruben Amorim has decided to substitute Manuel Ugarte and he is replaced by Bendito Mantato (Manchester United).
75' Ayden Heaven comes off the pitch to be replaced by Leny Yoro (Manchester United).
73' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
71' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) takes the corner kick, but Jose Sa reads it well and stops the effort.
70' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
69' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Manchester Utd keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
65' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the middle of the goal from distance, but Jose Sa hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
65' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) replacing Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare.

64' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) gets to a rebound inside the goalmouth, but even from this distance he misses the target and fails to score. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
64' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) drives a shot towards the bottom right corner from inside the box, but Senne Lammens leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
63' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
63' A clumsy foul by Luke Shaw (Manchester United) and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle. Free kick. Wolves will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
62' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
60' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' Jose Sa (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

54' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
54' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.

53' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Jose Sa pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
51' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
49' Dangerous play by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United). Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ruben Amorim gives a chance to Jack Fletcher (Manchester United) and Joshua Zirkzee is off.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header down inside the right post. 1:1.
44' The referee blows his whistle, Wolves are awarded a corner kick.

42' Matheus Mane (Wolves) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Senne Lammens!

40' What a chance that is! Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
39' Manchester Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
38' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the left post!
38' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
38' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Corner kick. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity.

36' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

33' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Jose Sa. This effort really didn't trouble him.
32' Jhon Arias (Wolves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
29' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester Utd.
27' 1 - 0 Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Jose Sa. 1:0.
24' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) is penalised for a foul. Thomas Bramall had a clear view and blows his whistle.

23' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Manchester Utd are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
20' A lofted pass into the box is met by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves), who rifles a shot just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
18' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.

15' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
13' Good movement by Casemiro (Manchester United), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
11' A pass by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
9' The Manchester Utd players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Manchester Utd, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

6' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Manchester Utd, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
4' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) swings in a cross from the corner, but Jose Sa reads it well and gathers the ball.

4' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
3' Thomas Bramall blows the whistle, Matheus Mane (Wolves) is penalised for a foul. Manchester Utd get a free kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Thomas Bramall will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
